text:
Slow session or not, we welcome your feedback and we regret that your recent experience with the Companion Animal Travel Desk did not match the standard of care you expected for your companion animal booking.

You explained that the process felt unclear, that the support you received did not keep pace with your travel plans, and that this left you frustrated during a matter that should have been handled with greater attention. That concern is taken seriously. The Companion Animal Travel Desk exists to guide passengers through companion animal travel from booking through pickup, and each stage should feel orderly, calm, and fully explained.

Your complaint has been reviewed with the staff member who handled the case, and the desk ledger has been checked against the service notes recorded during the booking. We have confirmed that the required steps were followed, but we also see that the explanation given to you was not as clear or as reassuring as it should have been. In work of this kind, a correct process is not enough on its own. Passengers need plain guidance, steady communication, and prompt notice of any service change that may affect travel plans or animal care.

To prevent a repeat of this experience, the passenger coordinator will reinforce the standard sequence for companion animal travel and will remind the team to provide fuller explanations at each point of contact. We will also review how follow-up notes are written in the desk ledger so that handovers remain clear when a case moves from booking to check-in and then to pickup. These are routine duties, but they matter because they shape the trust passengers place in Aurelia Skyways.

We are sorry that the service you received fell short of that trust. If you choose to travel again with a companion animal, the Companion Animal Travel Desk will be ready to assist with closer attention and clearer guidance.
